descriptor_docs.sub: Low-end weight below 200 Hz relative to the 200 Hz–1 kHz body.
descriptor_docs.punch: Low-frequency attack-to-body contrast. Higher means a harder initial hit.
descriptor_docs.click: Beater click at 2–16 kHz relative to the low-frequency attack.
descriptor_docs.bright: Body brightness at 2–8 kHz, after the initial beater click.
descriptor_docs.decay: Energy-weighted low-end duration in milliseconds. Higher means longer sustain.
